supersedes_for_future_execution.reason: The frozen high-motion DROID configuration completed but did not separate own-action output from temporal placebos. An independent first-principles audit identified that the deployment had never been checked against a known-good published forward-dynamics pathway. The completed result remains immutable; this amendment governs only a new diagnostic allocation.

scientific_legitimacy.claim_credit: The positive control can diagnose the pinned deployment but cannot earn DROID WAM qualification, ranking, or independent-confirmation credit.

request_contract.chaining: condition each later chunk on the final generated frame from the preceding chunk

official_positive_control.known_deviation: The frozen public robotics server uses --no-guardrails, so each request records guardrails=false. No other request-contract deviation is allowed.

frozen_gates.media_structure: all four outputs must decode as 640x720, 17 frames, 10 fps

decision_tree.positive_control_fails: Submit zero DROID requests, shut down the model server, teardown the GPU, and classify the pinned deployment pathway as failed.
decision_tree.positive_control_passes: Run the already-frozen 12-request DROID control matrix in the same loaded process.
decision_tree.droid_matrix_fails: Preserve outputs, abstain, teardown, and do not admit full-episode Phase B.
decision_tree.droid_matrix_passes: Require the prospective powered independent-session gate before full-episode ranking. The already-exposed diagnostic session cannot supply independent confirmation.
